blocks.source: ※筆者はこれの次作のエストポリス伝記２は高く評価しています。反面、その前作のこちらについての評価は低めです。結構、辛口かもしれませんがご了承ください。
blocks.translation: ※I rate its sequel, Estpolis Biography II, highly. On the other hand, my evaluation of this predecessor is rather low. I may be quite harsh, so please bear with me.

blocks.source: １９９３年の発売で、ＳＦＣとしては中期の作品に当たる。
blocks.translation: Released in 1993, it was a mid-period title for the SFC.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Content / Story

blocks.source: 主人公は英雄の子孫として、復活した４柱の悪神（四狂神）と戦うことになる。いかにもな王道ストーリー。
blocks.translation: As the descendant of a hero, the protagonist must fight the four resurrected evil gods (the Four Sinistrals). It is an archetypal heroic fantasy story.

blocks.source: オープニングでは、１００年前の英雄達が四狂神との決戦に挑み、勝利するまでのシーンが描かれる。このシーンはチュートリアルを兼ねて、自分で操作することになるが、正に『最初からクライマックス』で、インパクトは強い。
blocks.translation: The opening depicts the heroes of 100 years ago challenging the Four Sinistrals to a decisive battle and winning. You control this scene yourself as a tutorial, and it truly starts with the climax, making a strong impression.

blocks.source: なお、エストポリス伝記２では、この英雄達の物語が描かれる。時系列上は１の方が未来という事になる。
blocks.translation: Estpolis Biography II tells the story of these heroes. Chronologically, I takes place in the future.

blocks.source: ゲーム終盤には波乱の展開が待ち受ける。エンディングはどこかの有名漫画（１９８４年完結）とか、どこかのＡＲＰＧ（１９９２年発売）とかで見たような展開だけど、とりあえず感動。最初と最後の印象は強い。
blocks.translation: A turbulent development awaits near the end of the game. The ending feels like something seen in a famous manga that concluded in 1984, or in some ARPG released in 1992, but it is moving nonetheless. The beginning and ending leave a strong impression.

blocks.source: ……と、ここまではいいけれど、問題はゲーム中盤（全体の７～８割を占める部分）。物凄いお使いイベントの連続で、他に類を見ないほどにストーリーは退屈。イベントも何もなく町と町を繋ぐだけのダンジョンも非常に多い。序盤にメインメンバーの４人が揃った後、モチベーションとなる要素が少ないので、中だるみしてしまう。無意味にイベントとダンジョンが多くて、プレイ時間が長いことが拍車を掛けている。
blocks.translation: ......That is all well and good, but the problem is the middle portion of the game (the 70–80% that makes up most of it). The story is unbearably boring, consisting of an endless series of tedious errands unlike anything else. There are also many dungeons that do nothing but connect one town to another, with no events whatsoever. After the four main party members have joined early on, there are few elements to keep you motivated, causing the game to drag in the middle. The excessive number of pointless events and dungeons, combined with the long playtime, only makes matters worse.

blocks.translation: ※For reference

blocks.source: http://neetit.ken-shin.net/est1.html
blocks.translation: http://neetit.ken-shin.net/est1.html

blocks.source: しかし、他の人のレビューを見ると、シナリオが良かったという人が結構いる模様。終わり良ければ全て良しということだろうか……。
blocks.translation: However, judging from other people's reviews, quite a few people seem to have enjoyed the scenario. Perhaps it really is a case of all's well that ends well......

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Usability

blocks.source: 戦闘画面はフロンビューを採用。キャラクターグラフィックが正面向きで表示される。
blocks.translation: The battle screen uses a front view. Character graphics are displayed facing forward.

blocks.source: 戦闘システムは素早さが高いキャラクター程、「速く」「多く」順番が回ってくるというＣＴＢ的システム。何気にこの時代の作品としては珍しい。ただし、ゲージも順番も表示されないので、ちょっと分かり辛いかも。リアルタイム性の無いＦＦ４と言ったところで、それ以外の雰囲気はオーソドックスなＤＱ型。
blocks.translation: The battle system is CTB-like: characters with higher agility have their turns come around "sooner" and "more often." This is surprisingly unusual for a game from this era. However, neither the gauge nor the turn order is displayed, so it may be a little difficult to understand. You could call it FF4 without real-time elements; otherwise, its overall feel is orthodox and modeled after DQ.

blocks.source: このゲームにはＤＱと同じく敵にグループの概念があるけれど、単体攻撃でも特定の敵ではなく、グループしか対象に選べない。それ自体は同時期のＤＱと同じだけど、これは攻撃対象がグループ内からランダムで選ばれるらしく、弱った相手を狙ってくれない。
blocks.translation: Like DQ, this game has the concept of enemy groups, but even single-target attacks can target only a group, not a specific enemy. That is the same as in DQ games from the same period, but here the target seems to be chosen randomly from within the group, so you cannot aim for weakened enemies.

blocks.source: また、全体魔法やグループ魔法を使用した場合、一体ずつノロノロとエフェクトと結果を表示するため、そこのテンポは今一歩。
blocks.translation: Also, when using an all-enemy or group spell, the effects and results are displayed one enemy at a time at a sluggish pace, which hurts the battle tempo.

blocks.source: 戦闘メンバーは序盤に仲間になる４人でほとんどの期間を固定される。構成は『勇者』『魔道士』『戦士』『僧侶』といった具合にテンプレ通りで手堅い。ただし、終盤に離脱して、ラスボス直前にならないと戻って来ないキャラがいるのは泣ける。
blocks.translation: For most of the game, the battle party is fixed as the four members who join early on. The lineup is a dependable template consisting of a Luminary, mage, warrior, and priest. However, it is heartbreaking that one character leaves near the end and does not return until just before the final boss.

blocks.source: 敵の強さはボス・ザコ共に無難。強すぎるでもなく弱すぎるでもなし。メリハリは薄いけれど、安定感はある。
blocks.translation: The strength of both bosses and regular enemies is reasonable. They are neither too strong nor too weak. The difficulty lacks much variation, but it is consistent.

blocks.source: なお、敵の強さは無難と書いたけれど、実はバランスブレイカーもある。このゲームの魔法反射魔法『ミラール』は、味方の回復・補助だけは通すという優れもの。通常攻撃と魔法以外の攻撃は少ないので、これだけでラスボス含む、後半のボスは楽勝できたりする。
blocks.translation: I described the enemies as reasonably balanced, but there is actually a balance-breaking spell. This game's spell-reflecting spell, "Mirarl," is excellent because it still allows allies' healing and support effects through. Since there are few attacks other than normal attacks and magic, this alone can make the late-game bosses, including the final boss, easy victories.

blocks.source: エンカウント率はやや高め。中盤はお使い地獄と合わさって、難易度が高いわけでもないのに、途中で投げそうになってしまった。
blocks.translation: The encounter rate is somewhat high. Combined with the errand hell in the middle of the game, it nearly made me give up halfway through, despite the difficulty not being particularly high.

blocks.source: 持てる道具の数に制限がある割には無駄に宝箱が多く、手動で整頓させられるのは大変。中身も消耗品ばかり。
blocks.translation: Despite the limited inventory capacity, there are needlessly many treasure chests, and having to organize everything manually is a chore. Their contents are almost all consumables, too.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: 発売時期の割にグラフィックは地味かも。普通の中世風ＲＰＧなので際立った特徴もなし。ダンジョンは数は多いけれど、洞窟や塔ばかりなのは飽きるかも。ただ、敵グラフィックに関しては、２よりもサイズが大きくて迫力がある。
blocks.translation: The graphics may look plain for the time of its release. It is an ordinary medieval-style RPG with no standout features. There are many dungeons, but having them consist mostly of caves and towers may grow tiresome. However, the enemy graphics are larger and more imposing than those in II.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: いかにも王道ＲＰＧといった感じの曲調。派手さはないけれど悪くない。個人的に好きなのはフィールドやラストダンジョンの曲。ただし、音質は２と比較すると劣る。２にラストダンジョン曲のアレンジがあるので、比べてみれば差は歴然。
blocks.translation: The music has the feel of a classic heroic RPG. It is not flashy, but it is not bad. Personally, I like the field and final dungeon themes. However, the sound quality is inferior to II. Since II contains an arrangement of the final dungeon theme, the difference is obvious when you compare them.
